fig: Illustration of Employee / Workforce Medical Check-Up
title: Employee Medical Check-Up
body:
Employees are one of a company's most valuable assets. A healthy and qualified workforce plays an important role in improving productivity and supporting business performance.

Work-related illnesses or occupational accidents can result in significant losses for employers, employees, and the community that depends on the products or services they provide. Therefore, protecting employees from occupational health risks while ensuring a safe, comfortable, and secure working environment is essential.

To support workplace safety and employee well-being, the Indonesian Government, through its Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) regulations, requires employers to provide appropriate protection for the health and safety of their employees.
